hints.title: Displaced Position Identification
hints.text: Elements that already reside at their correct index nums[i] == i need not participate in any swap.

hints.title: Bitwise Mask Constraints
hints.text: Every element that must be swapped must share all set bits of the target constant k.

hints.title: Common Bit Intersection
hints.text: Compute the bitwise and across all out of place values to obtain the maximum feasible k.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear scan over elements accumulating bitwise and of misaligned entries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of swap graphs takes factorial time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains a running bitmask in O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Show that the necessary and sufficient bitmask condition is the intersection of all displaced values.
